timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: Isn't this just a lint rule?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial, one follow-up allowed)
timing.question: If the hook has a bug, are we locked out of our own database?

problem.quote: Last quarter that reset cost you two days of price-list edits and about 400 replayed orders.

approach.quote: The policy is a PreToolUse hook on Devin's shell tool, committed in the repo, that checks every command before it runs.

evidence.quote: the staging reset was refused with exit 2 and the reason text, and the test suite ran with exit 0.

next_step.quote: Next action: a CI check that parses the hooks file and replays the evidence table on every pull request.

must_mention.point: Exit code 2 from PreToolUse denies the call while exit 0 lets it run and other codes are only logged
must_mention.evidence_quote: the hook exits with code 2 and Devin is refused with a reason it can read; exit 0 lets ordinary commands run, and any other exit code is only logged

must_mention.point: The psql call is rewritten into the read-only wrapper through updatedInput instead of being refused
must_mention.evidence_quote: psql is not blocked, it is rewritten into the read-only wrapper through updatedInput

must_mention.point: The matcher is a regex on the tool name and a list of patterns matches any entry
must_mention.evidence_quote: the matcher is a regex on the tool name

must_mention.point: A broken hooks file or crashed hook fails open so the script itself must fail closed
must_mention.evidence_quote: a broken hooks file or a crashed hook fails open, so the guard simply does not run; inside the script I fail closed

must_mention.point: The bad migration patch was refused with an exit 2 reason and an audit log line as proof
must_mention.evidence_quote: When Devin tried to apply the bad migration patch, the hook refused it with a reason naming the destructive DDL, and the audit log has the line with the timestamp.

misrecognised_words: "star-exec-star" (spoken glob; transcript may render it as "star exec star")

accuracy.anchor: All five points correct and in Priya's terms; the matcher point came only at the T+60 checkpoint (anchor: 27–30 = cause, effect and fix all correct).

structure.anchor: Problem → approach → evidence → next step held in framing and update; Outcome → Evidence → Risk → Next action → Ask held (anchor: 22–25 = order held throughout).

customer_relevance.anchor: Opened with the two lost days and 400 replayed orders; one number per evidence sentence (anchor: 17–20 = leads with who was affected).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Every segment within ±5 s; one filler in about 8 minutes; no restarts (anchor: 13–15 = on target, ≤3 fillers/min).

recovery.anchor: Both objections acknowledge → boundary → evidence → offer; the interruption answered in one sentence (anchor: 9–10 = evidence and a next step each time).
